description: Full-bag gapping session - driver through lob wedge, mapping carries
diagnosis: Near-neutral swing path but face hangs open on long clubs (driver face 9.2 deg open vs path 0.6 deg). Right miss grows from 4i up. Short clubs show mild pull/draw bias. Iron contact solid; fat/thin lapses on partial wedges.
drills: Lead-hand grip check: 2-2.5 knuckles;9-to-3 toe-up drill with 8i then 4H at 70%
notes: Best of bag: 7i-9i smash 1.26-1.39 with clean gapping. Driver weakest club (163m avg, 66m spread). 4I/4H/3W all cover ~170-173m; 5I and 6I only 4m apart. No impact-point or attack-angle fields in this export.

description: 7-iron block, first trial of the stronger 2.5-knuckle grip
diagnosis: Grip-change transition dip, not a failed grip. After switching to 2.5 knuckles: faces 7-10 deg open, closure rate ~1850 deg/s vs 2400+ on good swings, dynamic loft up to 32-36 deg, club speed down ~5 km/h. Steering instead of releasing; speed converted to height and spin rather than distance.
drills: Half swings at 60-70% before any full swing;Sim targets face 0-3 deg open and side spin under 500 rpm;One ball per 45-60s with fresh regrip
notes: 16 shots in ~6 minutes - rapid-fire fatigue visible late in session. Dynamic lie averaged ~7 deg toe-down, flagged for fitting review. Counter-evidence grip works: shot 2 face 0.4 closed smash 1.35 139.9m; shots 11 and 14 near-straight on new grip. Expect 2+ weeks before power returns.

description: Iron block - 9I, 8I and 7I, first session after the grip change bedded in
diagnosis: Major improvement. Face angle average fell from +5.83 deg (25 Aug 7I) to +1.36 deg on the 45-shot 9I block, with 16 shots actually closed - the release is returning. Absolute side spin roughly halved (1226 -> 727 rpm). Face-to-path now frequently negative. Remaining issue is consistency not direction: strike quality still scattered (smash 0.51-1.35) with several duffs and short mishits.
drills: Continue 9-to-3 toe-up at 60-70%;Step 2 of progression: keep 9-to-3 length, raise speed to 80-90%;Only lengthen to full swing once face holds at speed
notes: CLUB LABELS CORRECTED at Steven's instruction: shots 1-4 logged as 7I were actually 8I; shots 6-50 logged as 8I were actually 9I; shots 51-53 were genuine 7I. Shot 5 does not exist. Sensor-garbage rows to disregard: shot 20 (smash 0.63, side spin -11935), 26 (smash 0.51, backspin -5509), 23 and 45 (carry 0.0). Shots 51-53 (7I) read smash 1.40/1.45/1.36 with dynamic loft 23.8-25.4 deg, backspin 3773-3949 and launch 16-19 deg. Initially flagged as artifact - retracted. The four columns are mutually consistent: a delofted strike converts energy to ball speed rather than spin. Either the 7I is strong-lofted (28-30 deg static) or club speed reads slightly low. TO CONFIRM: check the static loft stamped on the 7-iron - it sets the correct smash benchmark for the whole set. No impact-position, lie or closure-rate data (HISTORY tab only).

description: SGT Tour Championship Round 1 back nine at Trosper
type: SGT competitive round - back nine, 52 captures
diagnosis: NEW dominant fault: topping long clubs. Attack angle strongly POSITIVE on 3 wood (+4.5 to +10.7 deg) - hitting up on the ball from the turf - producing contact 14-30mm LOW on the face and carry of literally zero on at least four shots (3W totals 79.8, 110.3, 106.7; 8I total 131.5). Impact width also consistently heel-side (-5.9 to -27.6mm). Face control was worse than 26 Aug but is NOT the main cause of the score; one 8 iron at 11.8 deg open.
drills: Ball position check - likely too far forward for a fairway wood off the deck;Low-point drill: strike a coin/tee just ahead of the ball;Return to 9-to-3 at 80-90% before full swings
notes: Score +8 to +27 over the nine (+19). Good swings still present: 3W carries of 187.9m (smash 1.46, face 0.1), 192m (1.42), 183.4m (1.39), 155.8m (1.40) - so the club works when the low point is right. DATA tab averages for the round: 4H carry 57.6m / impact height -10.8mm; 8I carry 114.1m / -12.4mm; SW carry 64.6m / -7.3mm; 5I carry 85.9m / +23.9mm. Every club averaging low-face contact except the 5 iron. EXCLUSION: the 7 iron on hole 16 was a punch-out from behind a tree - flag shot_type=punch, exclude_from_stats=1 when the shot rows are logged. SGT Shot Data now logged: back nine 55 strokes (par 35, +20); hole-by-hole 5,4,8,8,4,7,6,7,6. FAIRWAYS HIT OFF THE TEE ON PAR 4s/5s: 0 of 6. Only 3 shots all nine were played from a fairway; 20 from rough and 2 from deep rough. Hole 17 shot 2 travelled 25 yds backwards to a tee box. Hole 16 shot 3 (21 yds) is the 7-iron punch-out to exclude. NOTE: on-screen finish read +27 while the shot data totals +20 for the nine - gimmie handling may differ; do not treat either as authoritative without checking. FACE ANGLE (14 full swings read, putts excluded): avg +0.22 deg, sd 5.21 deg, 7/14 in the 0-3 band, range -7.9 to +11.8. The average is the best yet (5.83 -> 1.20 -> 0.22) but the SPREAD nearly doubled vs practice (2.88 -> 5.21). Face is now centred but scattered - under tournament conditions the control loosened even though the bias is gone.
